definitions.explanation: Deep and broad knowledge acquired through study and academic pursuit. Implies a high level of intellectual attainment.

examples.japanese: {学識|がくしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: That is a person of learning.

examples.japanese: {学識|がくしき}⟦{経験者|けいけんしゃ}→経験者：18664_keikensha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: To hear the opinions of learned experts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧{学識|がくしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧、さまざまな⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{見識|けんしき}→見識：05527_kenshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: He possesses broad scholarship and has deep insight in various fields.

notes:
Describes academic knowledge and intellectual accomplishment at a high level. Often used in formal contexts when referring to experts and scholars.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学識|がくしき}⟦{経験者|けいけんしゃ}→経験者：18664_keikensha⟧: learned expert (a person with both academic knowledge and practical experience)
- {学識|がくしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: learned / scholarly
- {学識|がくしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧: deeply learned
- {学識|がくしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な: richly knowledgeable
- ⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧{学識|がくしき}: broad scholarship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧: knowledge — general knowledge on any topic, not necessarily academic
- ⟦{教養|きょうよう}→教養：09788_kyouyou⟧: education / culture — broad general education and cultural refinement
- ⟦{見識|けんしき}→見識：05527_kenshiki⟧: insight / discernment — emphasizes good judgment from experience and learning
- {博学|はくがく}: erudition / wide learning — emphasizes breadth of knowledge across many fields

REGISTER:
Formal. The compound {学識|がくしき}⟦{経験者|けいけんしゃ}→経験者：18664_keikensha⟧ is an official term used in government advisory committees and legal panels.
